install: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then python -m pip install -e .; fi

mutation.adapter: Parse mutmut results text or .mutmut-cache into targets[]: one target per source file with total/killed/timed_out/equivalent/survived counts.

notes: Copy this file to quality-gate.config.json in the adopting repository root and keep mutation.report at artifacts/mutation-report.json.
The shipped quality-gate.yml passes this file to mutation_gate.py run --config on every pull request and trunk push; MUTATION_COMMAND is only a fallback.
pytest-bdd (or behave) is the industry-standard BDD runner for Python; pytest --junitxml produces the acceptance artifact.
mutmut is the standard open-source mutation testing tool for Python; the text results are normalized by the adapter.
radon cc src/ -s -n B is a second complexity opinion alongside the stdlib AST and Lizard engines.
Add services: or testcontainers when acceptance tests require real middleware.
Never mark a gate command non-blocking or ignore its exit code.
